variants.label: negation ends at a numeric operand
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 22 = y; pin 21 = z;
y = a & !'b'1; z = a # b;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 22 = y; pin 21 = z;
y = 'b'0; z = a # b;
variants.vectors:
ORDER: a, b, y, z;
VECTORS:
0 0 L L
0 1 L H
1 0 L H
1 1 L H

variants.label: standalone negated zero
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 22 = y; pin 21 = z;
y = !'b'0; z = a;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 22 = y; pin 21 = z;
y = 'b'1; z = a;

variants.label: adjacent negations belong to their own operands
ordinary constants remain unchanged
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 22 = y;
y = 'b'1 & a;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 22 = y;
y = a;
